name: btcpay
summary: Self-hosted cryptocurrency payment platform for merchant checkout, invoicing, and wallet-connected operations.
why_it_matters: BTCPay preserves useful self-hosted payments capability knowledge, but there is no current validated Vrooli workflow that justifies maintaining it as an active supported integration.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs self-hosted Bitcoin or Lightning payment acceptance.
Operators want sovereign payment infrastructure instead of a third-party processor.
A commerce workflow needs invoicing or settlement tied to crypto-native tooling.

platform_support.notes: Containerized deployment is portable, but payment node setup, networking, and wallet operations add significant operational complexity.

prerequisites: Defined operational ownership for keys, backups, and settlement
implementation_notes: Future support should scope the supported payment rails instead of exposing the entire BTCPay surface.
Promotion should define secret management and wallet backup semantics early.
Keep the boundary between scenario logic and payment infrastructure explicit.
operational_notes: Key custody and backup procedures matter more than initial startup.
Operator ergonomics depend heavily on Lightning and node choices.
Validation should include invoice creation and settlement visibility.
risks: Payment infrastructure creates real financial and operational blast radius.
A low-depth wrapper could mislead users about support quality and safety.
